name: Pale Groves
source:
Maria Schubert, a young 24 year old woman, is missing. Her whereabouts were last discovered within the domain of 'Pale Groves', a quaint and mystifying area that's formed its solitary realm away from the ebbs and moans of urban life.  

Aya Celik is drawn towards this rather peculiar mystery and ventures forward into the bleak rabbit hole of Pale Groves. A chapter unfolds anew from a book forlorn, may Pale Groves never find us anymore.

[From [url=https://paxillus.itch.io/pale-groves]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
24岁的年轻女性玛丽亚·舒伯特失踪了。她的行踪最后被发现是在“帕莱格罗夫斯”的范围内，这是一个古雅而神秘的地区，形成了远离城市生活的潮起潮落和呻吟的孤独王国。

艾雅·塞利克被这个相当奇特的谜团所吸引，并冒险进入苍白树林的荒凉兔子洞。一本凄凉的书重新展开一个章节，愿苍白树林永远找不到我们。

[来自[url=https://paxillus.itch.io/pale-groves]itch.io[/url]]
